reproduction.purpose: Durable standalone fresh recipes for S22-owned cases not wholly represented by peer JSON. Join common_setup and one case's lines and execute with bash -s from any cwd. All repositories and outputs are new /var/tmp fixtures. Commands intentionally assert the measured vulnerable behavior; repaired bytes must be judged against a refusing expectation instead.
common_setup: export TMPDIR=/var/tmp LC_ALL=C GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_NAMESPACE SOUJI_VERIFY_BIN SOUJI_QUARANTINE_ALLOW_LIVE SOUJI_Q_TEST_HOOK SOUJI_Q_SELFTEST_ACTIVE

record() { git -C "$R" add -A; tree=$(git -C "$R" write-tree); if [ -n "${1:-}" ]; then tip=$(printf 'fixture\n' | git -C "$R" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$1"); else tip=$(printf 'fixture\n' | git -C "$R" commit-tree "$tree"); fi; git -C "$R" update-ref refs/heads/main "$tip"; }
pushed() { git -C "$R" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main "$tip"; git -C "$R" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/main; }
digest() { (cd "$1" && find . -path './.git' -prune -o -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r sha256sum | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); }

unpushed-stale-bypass: printf 'local-only committed replacement\n' > "$R/.scratch/artifact.out"; record "$parent"; touch -d '3 days ago' "$R/.scratch/artifact.out"
readonly-index: printf 'same bytes\n' > "$R/artifact.txt"; record; pushed; touch -d '7 seconds' "$R/artifact.txt"; unset GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS
before=$(sha256sum "$R/.git/index" | cut -d' ' -f1); verify "$R"; after=$(sha256sum "$R/.git/index" | cut -d' ' -f1); test "$before" != "$after"
touch -d '14 seconds' "$R/artifact.txt"; before=$(sha256sum "$R/.git/index" | cut -d' ' -f1); vault "$R"; after=$(sha256sum "$R/.git/index" | cut -d' ' -f1); test "$before" != "$after"
